locator.section: Stereochemical control of Cl. loss from stereoisomeric chloronorbornanones (OE+. fragmentation)

evidence.curator_note: EI molecular-ion (OE+.) fragmentation. Equation 8.24 shows FOUR stereoisomeric chloro-bicyclo[2.2.1]heptan-2-one (chloronorbornanone) radical cations - panels (a) 80%, (b) 2%, (c) 14%, (d) 4% - all losing Cl. to a COMMON even-electron acylium ion drawn at the centre, (cyclopent-3-en-1-yl)acetyl cation [cyclopentenyl-CH2-C#O]+ (C7H9O+, m/z 109). This record is panel (a) (80% yield of the Cl-loss channel). The large spread of yields is the point of the figure: the fragmentation is STEREOCHEMICALLY controlled. STEREOCHEMISTRY IS NOT ENCODED in the mapped_smiles - panels (a)-(d) share the SAME constitution (Cl on the ring carbon C6 adjacent to the alpha-cleaving bridgehead C1) and differ only in endo/exo and syn/anti configuration, which a plain constitutional SMILES cannot capture. The four records therefore carry identical precursor/product SMILES and differ only in the printed yield and this note. MECHANISM (net, no H migration): the ionized carbonyl initiates alpha-cleavage of the C1-C2 ring bond to build the acylium C2#O8; the released radical relays to form the ring C1=C6 double bond while the C6-Cl bond homolyzes and Cl. departs. Net C7H9ClO+. -> C7H9O+ + Cl.. Book draws 4 electron-pushing arcs on panel (a): the fishhook at the ionized carbonyl O+. (odd electron -> forming acylium C#O pi bond), an arc across the alpha C1-C2 ring bond, the large sweep that forms the ring C1=C6 double bond, and the arc at the C-Cl bond (Cl leaving). Full electron balance of this radical-cation cascade needs 5 fishhooks because BOTH homolyzing sigma bonds (C1-C2 and C6-Cl9) must route each of their two electrons separately: moves 1,2,3,4 correspond to the four drawn arcs; move 5 (the second electron of the C6-Cl9 homolysis routed onto the departing Cl.) is the implicit homolysis hook required for electron balance and is not drawn as a separate half-arrow on the page.

No MOD rule is cross-linked: rule_index by_equation has no entry for '8.24'. This chloronorbornanone -> cyclopentenylacetyl-cation skeletal rearrangement is not among the encoded German-edition rules.

observed_mz 109.0648 is the curator-computed monoisotopic m/z of the (cyclopent-3-en-1-yl)acetyl cation C7H9O+ (electron-mass corrected). The page prints the yield '80%' for panel (a); relative_intensity=0.8. The m/z value is curator-computed (the central common ion carries no printed m/z).
